notes.title: Playtest for NextFest
notes.content:
🎉 Next Fest Update: Extended Playtest and New Patch Live! 🎉

We’re excited to announce that due to the fantastic feedback and enthusiasm from the recent playtest, we're keeping it active throughout Next Fest!

Patch Highlights:

New Questlines: Embark on the start of two new questlines, adding more depth and adventure.
Enhanced Audio: Experience updated sound effects designed to immerse you further.
Gameplay Balancing: We’ve fine-tuned balance based on player feedback to keep the experience engaging.
Extended Play Sessions: Play longer with extended timer settings.
Bug Fixes: Enjoy a smoother gameplay experience with our latest fixes.


So gear up, get blastin’, and dive into Next Fest with us!
